```java
package com.android.tools.lint.checks;

import com.android.annotations.NonNull;
import com.android.tools.lint.detector.api.BinaryResourceScanner;
import com.android.tools.lint.detector.api.Category;
import com.android.tools.lint.detector.api.Detector;
import com.android.tools.lint.detector.api.Implementation;
import com.android.tools.lint.detector.api.Issue;
import com.android.tools.lint.detector.api.ResourceContext;
import com.android.tools.lint.detector.api.Scope;
import com.android.tools.lint.detector.api.Severity;
import com.android.tools.lint.detector.api.ImageInfo;

import java.util.Locale;

public class IconDetector extends Detector implements BinaryResourceScanner {

    public static final Issue ICON_EXPECTED_SIZE = Issue.create(
            "IconExpectedSize",
            "Icon has incorrect size",
            "There are predefined sizes (for each density) for launcher icons. You should follow these conventions to make sure your icons fit in with the overall look of the platform.",
            Category.ICONS,
            4,
            Severity.WARNING,
            new Implementation(IconDetector.class, Scope.BINARY_RESOURCE_SCOPE)
    );

    @Override
    public void visitBinaryResource(@NonNull ResourceContext context) {
        String folderName = context.getFile().getParentFile().getName();
        if (!folderName.startsWith("mipmap")) {
            return;
        }

        String fileName = context.getFile().getName();
        // Only check raster image files
        String lower = fileName.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
        if (!lower.endsWith(".png") && !lower.endsWith(".webp") && !lower.endsWith(".gif") && !lower.endsWith(".jpg") && !lower.endsWith(".jpeg")) {
            return;
        }

        ImageInfo imageInfo = context.getImageInfo();
        if (imageInfo == null) {
            return;
        }

        int width = imageInfo.width;
        int height = imageInfo.height;
        if (width != height) {
            // Launcher icons should be square; could report separately, but skip size check if not square
            return;
        }

        int expectedSize = getExpectedSize(folderName);
        if (expectedSize > 0 && width != expectedSize) {
            String message = String.format(
                    "The icon '%1$s' in folder %2$s has size %3$dx%4$d, but it should be %5$dx%5$d for this density.",
                    fileName, folderName, width, height, expectedSize);
            context.report(ICON_EXPECTED_SIZE, context.getFile(), null, message);
        }
    }

    private static int getExpectedSize(String folderName) {
        // Default density (no qualifier) is mdpi
        if (folderName.equals("mipmap")) {
            return 48;
        }

        String[] parts = folderName.split("-");
        for (String part : parts) {
            switch (part) {
                case "ldpi": return 36;
                case "mdpi": return 48;
                case "tvdpi": return 64;
                case "hdpi": return 72;
                case "xhdpi": return 96;
                case "xxhdpi": return 144;
                case "xxxhdpi": return 192;
                default: // continue
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }
}
```
